info.title: clip
info.description: Cross-platform clipboard bridge — copy from stdin, paste to stdout, clear.

options.name: --copy
options.description: Force copy mode (read stdin to clipboard), overriding autodetect

options.name: --paste
options.description: Force paste mode (read clipboard to stdout), overriding autodetect

options.name: --raw
options.description: Do not strip trailing newline on paste

options.name: --primary
options.description: Target X11/Wayland PRIMARY selection (Linux only; ignored elsewhere)

options.name: --describe
options.description: Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

options.name: --color
options.description: Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never
